description: Land Acquisition - Walgama - West, Biyagama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing the acquisition of two land lots (1.6479 hectares total) in Walgama West village for public purpose. It contains detailed land descriptions, extents, present uses, and claimant information, along with procedures for compensation claims. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals exclusively with land acquisition matters.
